notes: __await is transcribed to a native class; __asyncDelegator’s single original callable factory use is changed to new while preserving its constructed value. The direct factory-only external API is a documented class-transcription adaptation.
retainedHelperFixes: The original self-memoizing __assign variable/function-expression layout is retained, including short-circuit allocation of the fallback function, the live named export and original default-export snapshot.

Iterator checks occur at the original property reads and calls, preserving getter order and returned identity. Raw done values, including 0 and a nonempty string, are retained without Boolean coercion.

The original __await constructor becomes a native class. The single original __asyncDelegator call to its callable factory becomes new __await; a focused fixture verifies the resulting value, prototype and delegation behavior.

The __extends temporary constructor becomes a native class returning the original prototype-shaped object, since native class prototype properties cannot be reassigned. The original derived constructor/static-parent relationships and own constructor descriptor are checked.
The symbol-array local in __rest is named symbols instead of reusing the earlier string loop variable p; iteration and property order are unchanged.
